articles.summary: The search for extraterrestrial intelligence (SETI) is mostly concerned with where to look for technosignatures from another civilization. articles.title: 'Stupendously large' primordial black holes ruled out as a dark matter source
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Primordial black holes are hypothetical objects that could have formed directly from dense clumps of matter in the very early universe. If they exist, their dramatic origins would set them apart from the black holes we see today, which form when massive stars collapse. Some theories suggest that "stupendously large" primordial black holes could account for a significant share of the universe's elusive dark matter.
